verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents its own REST API, including fault and project read endpoints and ingestion endpoints for exceptions, source maps and deploys. Its official MCP server adds project management, error investigation, BadgerQL queries and dashboard create/update/delete. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full API–UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented parity claim or a full management API reference covering settings, alarms, integrations, uptime, check-ins, status pages and team/account administration; a published OpenAPI spec; independent corroboration.
